summary: Phase C backend testing — 17/17 tests passed after fixing one critical regression. Favorites (toggle/list/merge) all work, auto-waitlist flips product status to liste_attente on stock=0, GET /customers/{cid} returns {customer, orders, metrics} as expected (route shadowing fix verified), and Phase A/B smoke tests pass. Found and fixed a critical regression: @api.get('/products/{pid}/history') decorator at server.py L2206 was orphaned (no function below it) causing (a) /products/{pid}/history to be bound to account_favorites and (b) product_history to be an unreachable function.

critical.issue: Orphaned @api.get decorator at server.py L2206 — the Favorites section was inserted BETWEEN the decorator and the product_history function body. Result: /products/{pid}/history was shadowed by account_favorites (which has no pid param) and product_history became unreachable. Fixed by moving the decorator back directly above product_history. Regression test added (test_product_history_route_regression).

action_items: Review the fix I applied around server.py L2206-2270 (decorator relocation). The product_history function now has its decorator; it was previously orphaned.
Still open from iteration_11: extend ProductIn Pydantic schema with the 14 Phase B fields so POST /api/products persists them.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2886 lines — continues to exceed the 700-line guideline. Split into routers (products, customers, orders, pos, cms, public_account).
The orphaned-decorator bug is a strong signal that inserting new endpoint groups mid-file is risky. Prefer appending new endpoint sections at the end of the file or in dedicated router modules.
Auto-waitlist logic in create_order runs a fresh find_one per item inside the loop — fine for small carts but N+1 pattern; consider batching if cart sizes grow.
/public/account/favorites/toggle does not validate that product_id refers to a real product — favorites can point at deleted/non-existent products. Minor but worth validating.

rca of the issue: Reproduction: before fix, GET /api/products/{any_id}/history would call account_favorites (which Depends(get_customer)), so with admin bearer it would 401; the actual product_history logic was dead code. Root cause: when the Favorites block was inserted (lines 2208-2235), the pre-existing `@api.get('/products/{pid}/history')` decorator at the top of what became the Favorites section was separated from its target function `product_history` (which still lived at L2259 but lost its decorator). Fix applied: moved the decorator back directly above `async def product_history(...)` and removed the dangling line. Verified green via test_product_history_route_regression.
